name: Varyo Bundles – Product Bundles, Quantity Discounts & BOGO for WooCommerce
author: Varyoapps

sections.description:
Varyo Bundles lets WooCommerce stores create product bundles, quantity breaks, bulk discounts, and Buy One Get One (BOGO) offers on existing product pages. Customers choose a deal next to the add-to-cart button, including discounted quantities, free gifts, upsells, and companion products.

No separate bundle product type or duplicate catalog items are required. Create an offer once, target products or categories, and Varyo handles the storefront display, variation selection, cart pricing, and validation.

See Varyo in action

Create your first bundle offer in about two minutes:

Need help setting up an offer? Open “Need help?” in Varyo admin to start live chat or email us.

Three offer types

  • Quantity Breaks: tiered pricing and bulk discounts that reward buying more, such as “Buy 2, save 10%” and “Buy 3, save 15%”. Percentage off, fixed amount off, or a fixed total price per tier.
  • Buy X Get Y: classic BOGO and beyond. Buy X items, get Y items free or discounted.
  • Product Bundles: pair the main product with companion products at a bundle discount, in horizontal or vertical layout.

You choose the deal. Varyo handles the pricing, cart logic, and validation.

Guides

  • 2-minute setup video
  • Setup guide
  • Quantity Breaks
  • Buy X Get Y
  • Product Bundles
  • Free gifts and free shipping

Free gifts and upsells on any offer

Attach a free gift (added automatically), free shipping, or an opt-in discounted upsell to any deal bar, including variable products with an inline variation picker.

See the money it makes

The analytics dashboard shows views, orders, conversion rate, and added revenue, the extra money your offers generated, per offer and per month. You’ll know exactly whether a deal is working, not just that it exists.

Designed to look like part of your store

  • Visual style controls for colors, borders, spacing, and badges. No CSS required.
  • Live preview in the admin: see the exact widget, with real product prices and variation pickers, while you build the offer.
  • Works with variable products end to end, with server-side validation of every selection.

It should look like part of your store, not another plugin bolted onto it.

Works in every store language

Works with Polylang and TranslatePress: translate every offer into each store language, and shoppers see the product page, cart, checkout and order emails in their own language.

Light enough to forget it’s there

  • About four database queries per product page, flat, whether you run 5 offers or 100. Offers are batch-loaded and matched in memory, never queried one by one.
  • Cart pricing computes in under a millisecond, even with many deals in the cart.
  • The analytics dashboard reads pre-aggregated counters and never scans your orders table, so it’s as fast at 10,000 orders as at 10.
  • No React app or render-blocking assets. Optional usage reporting is off until an administrator opts in.
  • The admin support bubble offers live chat and email. Crisp chat loads only after you choose Start live chat; for 30 days after a chat, Varyo admin screens reconnect to it so you see our replies. It never loads on your storefront. Email requests are sent only when you submit the form.
  • No custom database tables. Everything lives in standard posts and meta, and uninstall can remove all offers, settings, and analytics (or keep your data, your choice). Order history is never touched.

Built the WordPress way

  • Discounts are applied through WooCommerce’s own cart pricing hooks, so totals, taxes, and order emails are always consistent. There are no display-only price tricks.
  • Compatible with the WooCommerce block Cart, Checkout, and Mini-Cart, and with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

Requirements

WooCommerce 7.0 or newer must be installed and active.

External services

Varyo contacts varyoapps.com (run by the Varyo developers) only when an administrator chooses to:

  • Update emails and usage data (optional): asked once after activation; nothing is sent unless you choose Allow & Continue. Once a day it sends your WordPress name and email, site URL, title and language, WordPress/WooCommerce/PHP versions, theme and currency, and Varyo usage (offer counts, features used, added revenue as ranges). Never customers, products, orders or exact revenue. Turn it off in Varyo Bundles → Settings → Data & Privacy; that also removes your details from varyoapps.com.
  • Support and feedback (optional): the support form and deactivation survey send only what you submit. Live chat uses Crisp and loads only after you start a chat.

Varyo privacy policy

Third-party libraries

Varyo Bundles includes Chart.js 4.5.1 under the MIT License for the analytics chart. Human-readable source is available at https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/tree/v4.5.1.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New and search for “Varyo Bundles”, or upload the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Go to Varyo Bundles → Add New, pick an offer type, choose the products or categories it applies to, and publish.
  4. Visit a targeted product page. The offer widget appears next to the add-to-cart button.

To show an offer elsewhere, place a WordPress Shortcode block inside a supported WooCommerce product add-to-cart form. Use [varyo_bundle] to show the highest-priority eligible offer, or copy [varyo_bundle offer_id="256"] from the offer editor or Bundle Offers list to choose a specific eligible offer. Varyo uses the containing form’s product, variation choices, quantity, and Add to cart button. A shortcode outside the form stays hidden.
sections.faq:
Does this create new products in my catalog?

No. Varyo shows offer widgets on your existing product pages. Your catalog, inventory, and SKUs are untouched.

Can I show a bundle offer on my homepage?

Yes. Add WooCommerce’s Single Product block to the homepage, edit its Add to Cart + Options area, and put a Shortcode block inside that area. Use [varyo_bundle] for the highest-priority eligible offer or [varyo_bundle offer_id="256"] for one published offer that targets the form’s product. Keep the Shortcode block inside the actual add-to-cart form; it can be below Add to cart. Classic WooCommerce product forms are also supported when the shortcode is rendered inside the form. The older product_id attribute still works when it matches the containing form. Product grids and featured-product elements that only link to a product page do not provide a purchase form. An unsupported form, an unpublished or bar-less offer, or an ineligible product leaves the selector hidden. Each form is handled independently. On the interactive Single Product block, submitting a selected bundle reloads the page through WooCommerce’s form handler so all bundle choices reach cart validation.

How are discounts applied, and will my cart totals and taxes be correct?

Pricing is applied through WooCommerce’s standard cart pricing hooks before totals are calculated, so the cart, checkout, taxes, order records, and emails all reflect the real discounted price.

Does it work with coupons?

Yes. WooCommerce coupons apply on top of the Varyo-discounted cart following WooCommerce’s normal rules. If you’d rather not stack them, restrict the coupon in WooCommerce’s coupon settings.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Quantity breaks, Buy X Get Y, bundles, and even gift/upsell add-ons support variable products with inline variation pickers.

Does it work with the WooCommerce block Cart and Checkout?

Yes. The block Cart, Checkout, and Mini-Cart flows are supported, including quantity changes made inside the blocks.

How many offers can I run?

Unlimited. Varyo Bundles does not restrict the number of active offers or drafts you can create.

When several published offers target the same product, priority decides which one is shown on the product page. The others are not shown but remain valid for that product, for example through a shortcode that names them. Unpublish or retarget an offer you do not want shoppers to use.

Will it slow down my site?

No measurable impact. The widget adds about four database queries to a product page regardless of how many offers you run; cart pricing completes in under a millisecond; and analytics are stored as pre-aggregated counters, so nothing ever scans your orders table during normal browsing. You can verify all of this yourself with the Query Monitor plugin.

Does it work with my theme?

Varyo renders inside the standard WooCommerce add-to-cart form, which virtually all themes output.

Does it support subscriptions?

No, subscription products are not supported.

Which orders count in Varyo Analytics?

An order is counted once, when it is paid (payment complete, or the order reaches Processing or Completed) and includes at least one Varyo bundle offer. Later refunds or cancellations are not subtracted, so Analytics shows bundle sales as they happened rather than net revenue. Use WooCommerce reports for refund-adjusted totals.

Can I translate my offers or change Varyo’s wording?

Yes. Go to Varyo Bundles > Translations. With Polylang or TranslatePress active, pick a language and translate each offer’s titles, subtitles, badges, and gift or upsell texts. Empty fields keep Varyo’s automatic text, and Auto-fill suggests translations for common deal wording in Spanish, French, and German. On a single-language store, the same screen lets you change Varyo’s storefront wording.

What happens to my data if I uninstall?

Your call: a deactivation option lets you keep all Varyo data for a future reinstall. With full removal selected, uninstall deletes all bundle offers, their settings, analytics data, and plugin options. Historical Varyo metadata already attached to WooCommerce order items stays with those orders, so past order records remain intact for accounting and support. Varyo never deletes or modifies your WooCommerce orders.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • Fix: Free gifts follow quantity changes in the cart and cart drawers.
  • Fix: Lowering a Buy X Get Y deal in the cart removes the free item.
  • Fix: “Order again” keeps deal prices and free gifts.
  • Add: A View button in the Offers list.
  • Update: Tested with WooCommerce 11.3.0.

1.3.0

  • Add: Free shipping as a deal bar gift.
  • Add: Highlights on deal bars.
  • Add: Bold text and line breaks in deal bar titles.
  • Update: Refreshed free gift and upsell cards in the offer editor.
  • Update: A free gift with no text now shows “+ Free gift”.
  • Update: Spanish, French and German translations for the new features.

1.2.1

  • Fix: Theme variant picker stays hidden on Product Bundle bars.
  • Fix: Compare-at price works on variable products.
  • Fix: Full deal-bar titles on the Offers page.
  • Fix: Offer editor no longer jumps on overlap warnings.
  • Update: Analytics tooltips match the Offers page.
  • Update: Complete Spanish, French and German translations.

1.2.0

  • Update: Redesigned Varyo main page (Offers) with an Overview of added revenue, orders, visitors and conversion rate.
  • Add: Results for every deal bar: orders, conversion rate and added revenue (recorded from 1.2.0 on).
  • Add: Live switch, duplicate, search, sorting and bulk actions with Undo for offers.
  • Add: Faster ways to reach live chat support.
  • Update: Improved usage sharing policy.
  • Update: Refreshed Varyo admin styling on all pages.
  • Fix: Offer views are counted on cached product pages.
  • Fix: Deal prices no longer change by a cent after picking a variation.

1.1.0

  • Add: Translations screen (Varyo Bundles > Translations) to translate your offers’ texts into each store language.
  • Add: Works with Polylang and TranslatePress. Offers show on translated products, and the product page, cart, mini-cart, checkout and order emails use the shopper’s language.
  • Add: Auto-fill suggests Spanish, French and German translations for common deal wording.
  • Add: Single-language stores can change Varyo’s storefront wording on the same screen.
  • Fix: Percentages use your store’s decimal separator.
  • Fix: Live chat now opens reliably the first time you start it.

1.0.10

  • New: Spanish, French, and German translations added.
  • Improvement: Live chat update for faster support.
  • Fix: Unpublishing or trashing an offer now removes its discount, free gift, and upsell from carts right away.
  • Fix: When a cart qualifies for several Buy X Get Y deals, the biggest one applies.
  • Improvement: Security, performance, and stability improvements.

1.0.9

  • Add: Live chat in the Varyo admin “Need help?” bubble, with email as an alternative.
  • Add: Optional price rounding for deal totals, with endings such as .99, .95, or .00.
  • Fix: Savings text for percentage deals no longer shows values such as 15.02% for a 15% discount.

1.0.8

  • Add: Bundle widget shortcodes.
  • Fix: Support WooCommerce Single Product / Add to Cart + Options blocks.
  • Fix: Keep bundle widgets responsive and block quantity controls in sync.
  • Update: Deactivation feedback options.
  • Fix: Accept store URLs without https:// in the support chat bubble and deactivation form.
  • Update: WooCommerce 11.1.2 compatibility.

1.0.7

  • Fix: Improve support form delivery during slow connections and reduce duplicate requests during retries.
  • Fix: Accept multilingual support messages and show when a prompt choice could not be saved.
  • Fix: Keep the review reminder out of the way after asking for help and align the setup-help banner on narrow screens.

1.0.6

  • Add: Optional usage sharing to help improve Varyo.
  • Add: An in-admin support form, free first-offer setup guidance, and an optional honest WordPress.org review reminder after an offer has been published for seven days.

1.0.5

  • Fix: Keep the deal you selected when two deals have the same quantity.
  • Fix: Accept valid product variations for free gifts.
  • Fix: Remove optional add-ons without removing the rest of the deal.
  • Fix: Keep cart prices and items correct when quantities or variants change.
  • Update: Tested with WooCommerce 11.1.2.

1.0.4

  • Fix: Refresh the block Mini-Cart and respect its automatic drawer setting after a successful bundle addition.

1.0.3

  • Fix: Keep WooCommerce quantities, qualifying QB/BXGY tiers, and cart quantities synchronized.
  • Update: Resize variant slots with the purchase quantity while preserving existing selections.

1.0.2

  • Fix: Limit each Free Gift cart line to its configured free quantity and charge excess units separately.
  • Fix: Show the correct Product Bundle companion name immediately after adding it in the editor.

1.0.1

  • Fix: Preserve decimal bundle prices such as 49.99 without rounding them to 50.00.
  • Update: Improve decimal price entry for Product Bundle items.
  • Fix: Show actual quantities in deal bar headings instead of placeholders such as {quantity}.
  • Update: Add WordPress 7.1 compatibility and WooCommerce 11.0.1 testing.

1.0.0

  • Add: Initial release of Varyo Bundles.
  • Add: Quantity Breaks, Buy X Get Y deals, and Product Bundles.
  • Add: Free gifts, upsells, deal-bar customization, and live previews.
  • Add: Built-in offer analytics.
  • Add: Variable-product, HPOS, and WooCommerce Cart and Checkout block support.
